visual_accuracy.rationale: Lesson 2 accurately presents the binary-search problem and mostly correct array/target visualization, while Lesson 1's title frame is just an OBS screen-capture recursion and its mid-lesson content is poorly positioned within a browser with incomplete/less clear highlighting of the binary search state.

interactivity.rationale: Lesson 2 includes a well-formed, wired quiz gate with a real binary-search question, plausible options, a marked correct answer, and a matching gate node after act_found, whereas Lesson 1 has no available gate specs or plan and therefore no functioning checkpoint evidence.

narration_quality.rationale: Lesson 2 has clear, well-paced narration with spoken math rendered naturally and no LaTeX or garbling, while Lesson 1 has no transcript available and therefore provides no assessable narration.

sync.rationale: Lesson 2 provides timed visual cues that are mostly aligned with the narration, even if a few cues appear slightly early, whereas Lesson 1 has no transcript or timing data available and therefore cannot demonstrate any synchronization at all.

concept_accuracy.rationale: Lesson 2 accurately traces the binary search steps, explains the sorted-array halving logic and log derivation clearly, while Lesson 1 has no available transcript or lesson content to verify or learn from.

polish.rationale: Lesson 2 has a clean, centered, consistent dark-theme presentation with legible text and organized layout, whereas Lesson 1 is visually unpolished with an OBS recursion capture on the title screen, browser/UI clutter, excessive empty space, and off-center lesson content.

aggregator.explanation: All six dimension agents strongly favor Lesson 2, each with high confidence. Lesson 2 is judged superior in visual accuracy, interactivity, narration quality, synchronization, concept accuracy, and polish. The rationales consistently note that Lesson 2 presents a coherent binary-search lesson with accurate visuals, clear narration, aligned cues, a functioning quiz gate, correct conceptual explanation, and polished layout, while Lesson 1 lacks key evidence such as transcript, timing, gate specs, and suffers from major visual and presentation issues. There is no meaningful split among the votes, so Lesson 2 is the clear overall winner.
